text: Meh. Atmosphere is fun . Drinks are great. Service is spotty. Food isn't good. Just stick with nachos. My fish tacos did not have flavor.  My husband's beef ones were okay. Really pricey for not much flavor
Their food is so amazing! I have nothing but good things to say about this business. They have done so much during cover to support other local businesses and families.

Perennial favorite NEVER disappoints ! Best smoked fish brunch platters around , along with delicious omelettes and special pancakes (peach cobbler !). Always stellar, friendly service ...and with nice weather here, no place lovelier than their 9 outdoor tables for weekend brunch !

Upon returning to my side of town on Sunday evening my body decided it would not be making dinner for us. I suggested to the driver that we hit up Canes. My place of employment is in the same parking lot so I see the long lines all the time. We decided to drive by and check the length of the line. It was about 5 cars deep. We decided to go for it. This was around 4pm. The line went very quickly. They finally manipulated the parking lot so there is only one direction you can enter the drive thru. Thanks Covid for making these businesses make things easier on us. 
Our food was hot. The chicken was good and not chewy or rubbery as sometimes can happen. The Texas toast was delicious and our fries were crispy. I love the Canes sauce too. Everything was great! My only recommendation would be to calibrate the soda machine. Our soda was flat.
I had this a year ago and it was great. Brought my family back telling them it was awesome. It was not. Hope it was just a bad day. It was dry and not much whiz.
Hats off to the Baker at this establishment. The chocolate chip muffins are the best around and the other day I sampled the Roman apple cake. Everything is always delicious and fresh
Awesome, authentic Mexican food -- the meal was filling and scrumptious. I would come back here and recommend this place.

As a traveling health professional, I'm always looking for local bars and restaurants. The Brewer's Cabinet has far exceeded their reputation, especially during a pandemic. The staff is always welcoming and goes the extra mile every time. Melanie and Brent always make sure my beer is full and my meal is perfect. I haven't found a better local spot in the 7 states I'm travel between.

I'm not a vegetarian but I'm obsessed with this place and visit every time I'm in town for work. If you're looking for fresh, flavorful, healthy food at a great price then check them out. 

I've only tried a few dishes but they are great. My favorite is the sesame Tofu over brown rice. They have an extremely extensive menu so check this place out with friends and try a few different dishes. 

The entree portions are huge and can easily feed 3 hungry adults. Don't be turned off by the fact that it's vegetarian. Just check it out! You won't regret it.

Service was phenomenal, thanks to Ms. Dionne H.! She was pleasant and oh so very helpful. She was attentive and made us feel so welcomed. The food was spot on also. We ordered the fried chicken, crab beignets and crawfish bread. Everything was hot, fresh, and tasty. I was pleasantly surprised. Business was steady but not overall crowded which helped us to get in and out. Perfect place to watch the Saints game!
Came by last night and ordered take out. Pepperoni and sausage pizza.  It was pretty good. Also had Buffalo wings. Not bad. Family of 3. We enjoyed it.

Great tasting food! So glad we happened into this gem of a strip mall corner restaurant. Thank you for feeding my family wonderful food! Don't be fooled by the listing, no burgers. Although, everything we chose was amazing and I am glad I didn't have the choice of a burger. We had the steamed mussels, the sauces was amazing. For entrees chicken saltimbocca and the penne, our daughter had the fried chicken strips and they were so juicy. The saltimbocca was soooo good.

Delicious chicken! Definitely yummy, although our minds were not blown.

3 piece tenders were moist, tender, and perfectly breaded with a thin, crispy breading. The mild was hot enough for a non-Southerner like me. Hubby enjoyed his fried sandwich. Sides were well done overall - I really liked the coleslaw and southern greens. Crinkle cut fries were just ok. 

Easy online ordering, and my order was ready to go, right on time.
Amazingly delicious and so adorable and quaint to have lunch here or even take it to go! Keep on doing what you are doing! Ty!

We tried to order. They said no veal or seafood which makes up around 2/3 of the menu. They didn't have an updated menu of what they are serving. After arriving for our takeout seemed like they forgot about the order. 15 minutes later we got the food and brought it home. We took two bites of our chicken dish and it tasted like we were biting into a tire. Got sick after eating the nasty chicken. One of the worst meals I have ever had. Can't see them lasting providing rubber chicken and no food-great business model. Just hope something good like the old French place can come back their food was actually edible. Waste of a hundred dollars to say the least. Probably cost them 25 cents for the Walmart tasting chicken breast... NEVER EAT HERE. U want good Italian food go to Forbici good food better price.

Quick & easy service during COVID. Tacos are $3 a piece, so it's delicious AND cheap! They aren't tiny either. 

I ordered 1 pulled pork, 1 chicken, and 1 fried avocado. Pulled pork was my least favorite of the 3. 

Great spot!
Good breakfast place, but nothing special that stood out. Wasn't disappointed with food quality. Seating was not the most comfortable. There's only one bathroom in the whole place.

Our first time. 

I am vegetarian and my wife is GF. We ordered Pad Thai, Red Curry and Pap Salad. To share things, we asked the owner to put Tofu and Chicken in separate containers. Very nice she did that.

The Red Curry was good, but too many bamboo shoots and the pad Thai was ok, it needed something.

All of this said, we will give hem another try now knowing more about how they produce things. 

Don't go by me, give her a try.
If you aren't wearing a mask you are risking your life, mine and everyone you come in contact with.  Please wear a mask over your mouth and nose.

Ordered take-out about a month ago.  Food was good--fried chicken reheats nicely for leftovers.  I just really wish they had a kids menu.  My kids didn't like the "grown-up" burger.  Unfortunately will not likely come back because they don't have simple kid food.
Best Cheesesteak I ever had, friendly service, seemed like they were genuinely upset I couldn't eat at their place

If you want the kind of "traditional Mexican" food that you get from most Mexican restaurants in this part of the U.S. then you may be disappointed. To give an example, I get chimichangas at places like La Carreta's, etc. That said the Velvet Cactus has THE BEST appetizers in the world. Their queso dip, tex mex egg rolls and crawfish Bandidos are fantastic-- to name a few. They also make a good chicken quesadilla. Their menu (as previously stated) is truly unique, but they have their own flavor that really works for them. The ambience is wonderful as well. PS:  If you want a delicious (and unique taco) try the velvet steak taco...again it's not like a taco that you'd get at most other places, but it's FANTASTIC.

I only wish I could give this joint 6 Stars.  If you like Pizza - REAL PIZZA -  this is your place.  However, if you call these "we'll deliver our crap product to your front door" type pizza places you see on TV during the ballgames, then stay away!  Your pallet is conditioned to cardboard with sauce on top.

Delorenzos crust is like a circus in your mouth.  It's thin and crunches from the first bite.  The texture is perfect 100% of the time.  I add the pepperoni and my wife tell's me "you're happiest when that pizza is in front of you". It's the best!

Pandemic got you down?  Go get a couple of pies and take them home.  You'll be a rock star to your kids for 15 minutes.  

I stumbled upon their Trenton location while dating a young lady in the late 80's  when I lived in Bucks County full time. Twice a week I would drag this girl over there and we loved it!  These days I spend 60% my time in Newtown & NYC (& the rest of my time in Chicago where the deep dish "famous" for being nothing special).  I feel blessed that Delorenzos opened this location nearby.  It's a treasure to this community.  My only complaint?  I wish they had a loyalty club so I could get some free grub once in a while.  But you know what?  The product is so good they need a loyalty program to bring us all back!

The Service?  A+++
The Product?  A+++
The Price? A++++++  I have NEVER left this place and felt as though I did NOT get my money's worth.  

As I said earlier, if you're a rube who enjoys Domino's, P

Cute roadside drive-in that was featured on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives. My Kale salad with Gilles chicken was very good and filling. My husband got the prime rib meal (roll, garden salad, mashed potatoes and slice of prime rib)...he sAid it was okay, but not worth all the hype as portrayed on tv. Same goes for the Famous Idaho Ice Cream Potato...it was just okay. It wasn't a knock it out of the park, but still a nice place to go for a quick casual meal with the kids.
Great spot! Friendly staff and lots of fun things in gift shop area. Tasty cappuccino and berry scone. :)

I have finally found my place to go to for Nashville Hot Chicken and Fish. It is called Big Shake's Nashville Hot Chicken and Fish.It is very juicy,crunchy,and it is dry seasoned not wet. They have many degree of Hotness from Mild up to executioner. I had 3 chicken tenders stop drop and roll flavor and a waffle and My husband had Hot Nashville Catfish Cry Baby flavor with French fries and slaw. The portions are very plentiful and the food  comes to you fresh and hot. The only bad thing I have to say is their diet sodas were out and it take awhile to get your food. So I would recommend you take a snack with you while you wait for your food.It is definitely a place to check out.

Dropped by early on a Saturday night. I am a vegetarian and had been so excited to try this spot. Loved the cauliflower appetizer- bursting with interesting flavors. The Brussels sprouts were good, but not out of this world. My veggie burger was sadly quite dry and tasteless. The kale salad that accompanied it was great. My husband thought his burger was excellent and said the quality of meat was very good. 

The thing that impressed me the most was how child friendly this place was. My daughter dropped a toy and a waiter quickly picked it up and asked me if he could sterilize it for me. Another saw my one year old and began sharing stories about his 14 month old.  There is a kids menu too. 

Even though the dish I picked wasn't spectacular, I look forward to trying many more items on the menu and am so happy that there is a restaurant with so many healthy options to fit the needs of those with many different diet limitations.

If I were a cow, I'd want to end up being this farmer's cow! I always get the moo caliente. It's pretty spicy. I ask for it without the charred habeneros. Ask mike to make you a cocktail .. he is the best. Chicken skins wasn't what I was expecting but they were amazing. Plus guy fierie was just filming here? Dope!!! As he says, this place is donkey sauce!!!

This is my first time here and I ordered the lobster bisque and it was to die for. Osh was our waiter and he didn't disappoint. He was spot on with his sangria recommendation. The blue point oysters were wonderful as were the lobster rolls. We will be back.

If you don't mind standing outside (because they don't want to buy more than one bench) waiting, then it I will make sense once you get inside. The service is slow, and no attention to what your needs are (ex. Empty glass, food does not come out the same time for your table). Parking is bad. If you can get past that and that doesn't bother you, and you have the time to spend, then the food is amazing!

The owner has a talent for food, but service is not in their background.

Stumbled upon this viet inspired restaurant while looking for places to eat in the neighborhood. It wasn't busy around 5:30pm on a weeknight so we were able to have the place to ourselves. Upon arrival you are greeted with a fragrant welcome of brewing pho. Since it was a hot summer day my friends and I opted for the cold noodle dishes and bahn mi.
I got the spicy peanut noodle which was refreshing but not spicy at all. It did not have any detectable spice, so I would ask for more next time. My friend's sesame noodle was a bit sour for our taste, so only get this if you like very tangy items.
The bahn mi was good though - the chicken was well seasoned on it and the pickled vegetables were just right. I personally love the creamy spread on the bread as well.
The service is good so if I were to come again I'd like to give their pho a try.

It took a while before our waitress Charlotte got to us to take our order but she made up for it with GREAT service! The food was good and the 1/2 price mimosas were flowing. It was nice to finally be out of the house!! We chose outdoor seating for the nice setup and to enjoy the sun.

I like First Watch and the food there, but I have a problem with this location. I typically visit Rooney Ranch in Oro Valley, however we were on this side of town so my wife, dog and I wanted to go here. I called ahead to see if dogs are allowed on the patio, since they are in Oro Valley. I did not know what the patio was like at this restaurant, which is why I called ahead. He said all dogs are allowed on the patio. I get there and wait outside with our dog while my wife checks us in. We wait for 15 minutes outside and then get greeted outside saying dogs aren't allowed on the patio. This location completely wasted our time and wasn't even apologetic about it.

I am the hardest to please when it comes to this style of cooking, ie southern bbq. Dukes is easily the best "southern bbq" I have had in the Midwest. I haven't been to any of their events but it looks like a pretty sweet set up! The servers we have had are so nice and I am normally too shy to talk but they were just so welcoming. Lastly, we have been here 3 times in a week. Get the pulled pork sandwich with the best coleslaw in Indiana. I love you Dukes!

This is my first time here and overall our experience was a good one.  You can definitely tell you're eating clean.  I do think the service could use some improvement.

I had the Sweet & Smokey.  I got it with the crispy chicken.  Overall the dish was good and all flavors went really well together.  My chicken was a little overcooked so it was a little dry.  Get the chicken right then you'll have a really good dish.

They don't have your normal soda brands like Coke or Pepsi.  I had the cola which was decent, but definitely didn't taste like a Coke.  I'm assuming it's probably much better for you.

I'll definitely come back for a light dinner during the work week.

The best! I've lived in Nashville 6 years and I'd say this is by far the best true meal and service I've had in the city. OAK ties with it ... for food and service as well.  If there's a special occasion this place has the vibe, ambiance, jazz and has excellent cocktails and food. I've been going here for years for cocktails and apps .. when I finally took my family who were visiting from out of town here for a Nashville meal -- they were also blown away!

I really like this place. The ambiance is terrific, the staff, friendly and the service, wonderful.  The only complaint i have with it (preventing 5 stars) is that, when my brother, father and i came to eat there and my father, who is 88, had trouble heating the waitress' answers to his questions and he'd asked her to repeat them,  she got a bit of an attitude. However, the food is delicious.

I love this place. Their food is really good and they give you a good amount of portion. I enjoy it. I thought having the Mediterranean breakfast may be too light or too little but I am surprised that it's not. It became one of my favorite breakfast because I love the different cheese selections that are included. Service is also very quick and nice. Definitely recommend.

Love the monkey business!! Always a winner... I have the strawberries chopped in and have it with Oreos, pandas, and condensed milk eggs sweet and simple! Everything on their menu is great... Worth trying each one!
I would like to Thank them for providing Mease Countryside Hospital with Delicious Food. By far the best vietnamese food i've had in a long time. Thank You Soo Much!!!!!

Ordered a bacon egg and cheese with tomato on an egg bagel.  A bit messy, not an on the go type of order.  The egg was mostly hanging off the bagel, but not the biggest of deals.  Nothing a reassembly couldn't fix.  Still a tasty breakfast sandwich.  The bagel was soft the tomatoes were fresh and ripe with an acceptably portion of egg and bacon.  Worth going back to try something else.  Only true concern is the line that formed while waiting, social distancing not really enforced.  Would suggest 6 ft marking on the floors.  Masks were on but partially over the nose doesn't count.
Great food, friendly staff, clean store and friendly atmosphere. Love their cheesesteak pizza and mozza wedges.

My wife and I were in Tampa this weekend and wanted to try a few places we'd seen on yelp. Datz Tampa was pretty good. I had the burger with Mac&Cheese bun and my wife had the chicken strips on a bed of mashed potatoes. Her meal was INCREDIBLE.  She was pleasantly surprised to get a biscuit and honey with her meal. My burger....to be honest.....was a little "meh."  The chips that came with it (covered in green onions and blue cheese sauce) were delicious. 
Another cool feature was the adjoining bakery next door. We grabbed a couple of sweets before heading back to the hotel.

Ordered dinner from here tonight for the family and everything was excellent! The chicken fingers were made to order (NOT FROZEN!!!) and my husband had the chopped steak with two sides.  They have easy online ordering and when I arrived the food was ready and hot! 

I also ordered groceries from their food market. Super easy online ordering and delivered the next day! Everything was very fresh and it was an overall great experience and the prices were extreme reasonable

When curry cravings hit me, they hit me hard and Tiffin has now become my number one place to try a huge variety of delicious curries, chai, and shareables.

The saying goes that variety is the spice of life and, along with the spice of curry, this is where Tiffin shines. While none of the curries are the best I've ever had in the city, Tiffen offers the widest selection of curries as well as daily rotating options. With almost a dozen vegan and vegetarian curries and another eight or so meaty curries, you really cover all the bases from spicy to sweet to savoury. My personal faves are the mango paneer and 5 lentil curry. Their chef's specials are also consistently fantastic. The best part is you get some toppings at the end so you can add some roasted garlic, pistachios, pickled toppings, or a wide variety of other finishes.

The funny thing is that your Tiffin platters offer options for 1, 2 or 3 curries but the plate remains the same size so you might actually get more value by sticking to one or two curries. The portions here are generous, the sides and shareables are ridiculously good and unique, and despite some big lines the ordering is lightning fast.

The large menu is complemented by a big, open, cafeteria-style space which has a very unique aesthetic. 

Overall the flavours of Tiffin are delicious and while there are certainly better individual curries across the city, nobody beats this place when it comes to the sheer number of options you can easily try.

I truly wanted to give Med Cuisine an excellent rating because the Park Place food court desperately needs some variety and better food options. However, the beef shawarma I ordered last time had an overpowering mint flavor in every bite. I felt like I was eating a mint sandwich and couldn't taste anything else. Also, the pita wrapper was overcooked and extremely hard to bite into. The kebab sandwich on my first visit, however, was very good. I hope that my second visit was just an off day for them. It's been a revolving door for restaurants at this mall, and I hope Med Cuisine will do well.
I love this place. I try to tell everyone about it so they can help me keep it open lol. Great  food great atmosphere. One of the most consistent restaurants in Delaware.

Absolutely fantastic!  We go to Hawaii every other year and love the local food there. When I saw Aloha To Go on Yelp, I looked at the menu and said - "yes"....  I love me some Loco Moco and theirs was spot on perfect. Gravy was nice and salty, sticky rice - perfection. Burger was well done and the egg was perfect!  My stepdaughter had the kahlua pork - "freakin' delicious", she said. Service was very friendly - you've gotta try this place if you're here.

Have really enjoyed Sullivans in many different locations, including in the past, this place. Not so much tonight. I ordered a bottle of wine, only to find out they were out of this. I ordered a New York strip, which arrived cold. I expect better, and I know they could do better.

Hands down the best Greek food I've ever had! Every aspect of the food I ordered was over the top perfection! Smooth hummus with amazing flavor, pita bread that was lightly toasted super fluffy and soft! Every veggie on my order was bright, crisp and farm fresh with flavor to match! Most shocking to me was the rice, I never expect much from the usual pilaf rice.  But this pilaf rice was incredible, soft fluffy and crazy tasty all by itself.  Then there's the falafels, OMG they pair perfectly with everything in my order!  Seriously the only bad thing I could say is paying almost $3 after tax for one 12oz can of Coke is the only minor issue I've got with this place. The cost of the food is worth every penny! Whoever made this food on 01-23-2021 at 4:45pm better not ever stop cooking here!  I will be back here every time I visit this area of St.Pete!

I've ordered the Bibibimbap and Spicy Pork Hot Stone Pot over rice from here - while the flavors themselves aren't that bad, I find the meats are often quite dry. Especially with the pork hot stone pot, the meat felt rather tough after many bites.

The low rating is mainly due to the fact that there are a number of better Korean restaurants nearby with much better alternatives and hot stone pots. Also, Tampopo's menu is quite limited in comparison to these restaurants.

This is a local spot in Franklin that is worth the hype. Their pasta is made fresh in the kitchen and they always do a wonderful job. They have fairly large portions and I am always impressed with the freshness of the ingredients and the presentation. My husband and I either eat here or order out from here at least twice a month. They are always friendly and their garlic bread is always hot and fresh!

Recommend highly!

I have been a regular customer for years and my visit today assured that I am done.  They have reduced a previously great menu down to a cheap fast food equivalent.  Making your tables look hip, doesnt help if your food sucks.  Since my long time favorite was removed from menu, I decided to try Kung Pao chicken.  Worst Ive ever had...anywhere!!  No flavor whatsoever.  Panda Express is twice as good for a third of the price.  Wont be back again.  Someone in management is either cheap, ignorant, or both.  Good luck with your garbage.
The happy hour is amazing! And it's one of the few happy hours in Santa Barbara that's available until 7pm. I love it here

Yet again back to ur old ways.. the hostess seating people had a huge attitude...our waitress was dominating... ordered the seafood tuti fruti and no flavor as well as the sauce extremely  watery.. i ordered the lobster mac and cheese, was over cooked and extremely spicy. It was to have smoked gouda and thete was no smoked gouda.  Asked the waitress and she said it was pepper jack cheese.( nothing on menu suggested spicy). I bring this up to the waitress and she was like what else can i bring to u so she brought a lobster roll. Again cold and it was slopped on a plate. Ive said this as well before when a salad comes out before the entree more than 2 minutes need to be given before stealing my salad away.. STAY CLEAR THIS PLACE NEEDS TO SHAPE UP

I love you guys. Great pie once again. Got the Margherita specialty pie for their Monday specialty pie special.  I added fresh tomatoes which made it a bit wet but I always fire up the small oven at home anyway to heat the slices so I knew this going in. 

Delivery was ahead of schedule. It decided to pour right then. Murphy's Law I guess for my delivery guy. He wasn't phased. It's that time of year for storms. 

All I've gotten from them is pies but I've been consistently happy. And when you find a good local pie place around you you're fortunate. Thanks!

This was my first time at this location. I came with my roommate and we were meeting some friends. We got there around 7:30 and had to ask if they were even open. We were probably people #1 & 2 on a Saturday, however it was raining so that probably kept people home. I ordered at first vanilla vodka and club soda and then cucumber vodka and club soda. We were shocked when we were ready to pay and drinks were only $5!? The bartenders were great and made the drinks very well. We left around 11 and by then it was getting uncomfortably crowded as this was the first weekend bars were able to re-open. Overall before the crowds it was a good, fun vibe.
First time on takeout from this restaurant. Several people told us that the food was good so we decided to check it out. Food is very good and the tamales are the best I've ever tasted.

This place knows what it's doing. 

We stumbled on this bakery in a rainstorm and the owner? manager? let us try King Cakes that we were interested in, as we are new to the idea. I had no idea there were so many kinds. 

The staff was so kind and the food... so good. 

It felt homey and approachable and I want to spend all my money there. Parking is great! Easy access and you could tell they loved their city. 

I appreciated the hospitality as much as the cake! So good, all around. 

Thanks BWB!

Just Ok burritos. Been here twice and it has left me underwhelmed both times. Would I eat here again if I was hungry and nothing else was open? Sure. But, would I walk past all the other eateries in DSP to get here? No.

This place does not give a shit about their employees. They make their employees stay even when they're super sick so you guys better check your food. The store owner doesn't give his employee's 15 minute breaks WHICH IS SUPER ILLEGAL BTW AND HE COULD EASILY GET SUED. If your employee is throwing up and doesn't feel good what makes you think they are obligated to stay and work for you when you don't even give them breaks? Trash. 11/10 would NOT recommend.
Be CAREFUL! - MANY cellphones have been stolen at night here!  Visit at your own risk

Went there for takeout and observed no social spacing in outdoor dining area. People were back to back. I was led past all the tables inside to get my order. Behind the bar a dozen employees were clustered together with no apparent logistical reason.

Why cant you pay at the hostess desk at the entrance? Meanwhile Toma down the street does it right with lots of spacing between tables.

If SB does a full shutdown due to to issues, the good actor restaurants can partially thank this place.
The food here is delicious everything from the huli huli chicken to the stir friend veggies was absolutely spot on, I totally recommend!!

My girlfriend and I are locals and came here for the first time tonight for Restaurant Week. The hype was strong, however the service and food were sub-par. 
We made the reservation for our anniversary and were seated promptly by a very nice hostess who recognized the special evening. 
The server showed up about 10 minutes later to say he would be with us soon. We waited around 15 minutes to take our drink order, which came another 15 minutes later... wait for it... our appetizers came out, they were delicious, however it's not hard to make a tasty fried app - we had the Crispy Korean Cauliflower and the Saigon Wings. The wings were very good, the cauliflower got soggy after about 10 mins, so I suggest eating it first. 
The main dishes came out at different times which was fine as we were sharing everything. The Piranha Roll was an enormous disappointment. We are avid seafood lovers and sushi/sashimi enthusiasts, this was an abhorrent abomination of a roll. The fish was mealy, and the roll looked as if it had been made last week. It tasted like it too; a bland roll trying to be disguised behind a light wasabi and avocado spread hidden under a few micro greens. We struggled through this dish and ended up leaving 1/3 of it for the kitchen. After that experience the Seared Scallops came out, they were quite large divers scallops and had an enjoyable flavor, they were slightly overcooked in my opinion, however I am bias to fresh caught local scallops that are seared in little mor

Waited 2 hrs for food I had ordered 4lbs of crawfish son and was about to get more. I was blowed dawg. This just a tourist spot for ppl but they crawfish was made by 3 slaves,'I'm talking about fire crawfish like yo uncle made it son. The crawfish was crucial. That bih was juicy and spicy son. I'll just mess with that.

I love this place!   It's my go to in Nashville.  The service is fun and efficient.  The owner is always there and talking with the guests (love you Nina).  The food is the best.  You can choose a soup, a rice dish, or a noodle dish and you will love it.  It's fresh and spicy.  Thank you Thai Esane  for being our #1 choice in Nashville.  See you soon.
Awesome food, great location. Great service. Loud, but fun.

As a Greek living in the US I can say that Meraki is really authentic Greek food. Souvlaki with chicken contained fry-style sauce and lettuce whereas souvlaki with pork contained paprika and tzatziki! This is how souvlakis are served in Greece! Try the Zeus French fries with lamb (choice of protein) sprinkled with fresh tomatoes, onion, and feta cheese.

The shrimp pizza with garlic sauce is one of the best pizzas ever. The crust is very tasty and the service is always top notch. Every time I order salad the ingredients within the salad are very fresh. It is truly a hidden gem in the Westbank!

Interesting concept. You get to order your burger exactly the way you want it ... protein, toppings, bun. My two teens, my wife, and I each got different things. We enjoyed them all. I couldn't stop talking about how great my California style chicken slider was. Spanish beef was also quite good.

That said, be aware that this is an order at the counter, sit at the bar or the table, they'll bring your food out kind of place.  (You can also do takeout.)

The food definitely has a gourmet quality to it (along with gourmet burger prices). But don't come in expecting a full service restaurant. It's no frills with great food.

With that expectation set, I'd definitely recommend.

My boyfriend and I love Brunchie's! The menu has so many different and delicious options, every time we go we always try new things! The coffee here is on point literally the best coffee I've ever had at a breakfast place ever. My favs are the Avo toast, the biscuits and gravy, and the Cuban. But everything I have tried is delicious, service is always great wish I could eat here everyday!
Absolutely EXCELLENT! Everything we ordered was perfect in flavor, texture and presentation.

Food was ok, standard fried fare. Calamari was a bit underdone. I come from a city whose price point for food is high so I didn't see a problem with the pricing, everything was quick and as expected. Service was simple but not hospitable. I wouldn't come back but can see why tourists like I would choose to dine here. 3 stars is the best explanation for this place. Not to sound harsh but you get what you expect and the view is the best part.

Exceptional service and great food! My friend Kiara and I went for brunch on Sunday and received prompt service, and fantastic cocktails. Our server Nicole was a delight!  Very knowledgeable, and helpful in suggesting drinks. We will most definitely visit again soon. Best place in Channelside for drinks and sushi.
Just tried Poke Falls on a couple of recommendations, and found it to be ok. Not the best, but ok and at reasonable price. Probably won't be back...

Once again this dominoes proves to be a massive disappointment. Janet is the worst driver as she clearly doesn't know how to route her orders for best quality or as of this evening, know how to verify an address!!! I got quoted 24 to 34 minutes for for delivery and call about 5 min before an hour to discover my order had 'already been delivered' across the street to some rando apartment/duplex area when I live across the street in a house. Learn your numbers janet!!!
This was my first time at potbelly's and it was sooo good. The pulled turkey and bacon were so good on this sandwich and the toasted bread was amazing! The salad was fresh and delicious too!
Stay away from the soggy fries & wedge salad ...my husband  barely made it home before he got sick from the food.

Love the pizza and they deliver to Star. We have been eating this pizza for years and it has only disappointed one time so I won't hold it against them. Everyone messes up sometimes. We have tried several things on the menu and can't decide on our favorite. The cheese twists on amazing and we get them every time.

HELLO GOODNESS!!!

You guys!!! I found the BEST hidden gem on the Southside! I came here on a Friday and had the best experience! You can smell the meat cooking from the parking lot. The service was excellent! There were 2 employees working and both of them were super friendly. They explained the menu and made some suggestions for us. We ended up splitting the Hoosier Smoked Brisket Philly Sandwich. It was HUGE! We got a pint of Mac n' Cheese. It was really watery but maybe I caught it on a bad day? 

They have a lot more options than I thought they would! Lots of local goodies inside too! My mom got the Egg salad and ham salad to go. There is a whole wall of BBQ and Hot sauces as well. I posted A LOT of pictures. I will most definitely be back!

Cody's has a great outdoors space! Make sure to check them out for all your breakfast favorites. We love the corned beef hash, the eggs benedict and the huevos rancheros. Reasonably priced and great service!

Experienced the worst Christmas lunch today with my family. We in total waited for 2hr without getting any food ordered on the table. Not even a piece of bread. We had to leave with empty stomachs for our other items in the agenda. 

I booked weeks ahead and arrived on time, was told to waiting for 15 min. That was ok for a hectic day. We were seated in the balcony and ordered quickly. We ordered quite a few starters as to help with the speed. No special request. But nothing helped. We were told one time that food would be late at the very beginning. Within the next 1.5 hr, not even a single waiter or waitress stopped by and offered help. Around 2 hr laters, our waiter brought us some soup gratis to ease our nerve, and then disappeared again. 

The resultant excused by stating there are too many people. If curio is unable to host so many people on a special day, it should not even open today. Dealing with a large number of orders is a common requirement in the restaurant business. 

A four star restaurant hasn't been so disappointing!
Really good food, would definitely recommend. We got takeout and everything was ready on time and delicious.

the food was good.  did not appreciate the front desk worker telling us to pick up after ourselves. everyone else left the trays on the tables. do
 your job. your not getting payed to only take orders. would have given 4 stars otherwise

We've never had a bad brunch at Yolk.  Even when I was doing Whole30, they went out of their way to make sure my breakfast was compliant (and awesome).  I tend to get the Santa Fe frittata.  The peppers are fresh- not picked- which makes a huge difference.  You can also upgrade for some pretty fabulous "bread" options.  Nutella crepes?! Yes, please.

Came in to have hot chicken because, well, Nashville. Ended up getting wings instead, and took the bartenders suggestion and got the dry rub. Delish. Ranch dressing was homemade. Atmosphere seemed fun, but I was there before the happy hour crowd so it was empty. From the way it was getting geared up, though, I have no doubt it's a fun place. Bonus and the best part of this place- free valet parking!

I have been going to this In-N-Out burger for so long and have had nothing but good experiences but, today I found mold on my bun. I am super disappoint and now worried that this isn't the first time i've had mold on my food but didn't notice...

Comfortable dining experience.  Each item has its own presentation and delicious taste. We started with Fried Feta-so good!  Man courses were Fried Chicken cutlet-fabulous fried,  Lamb & pasta-rich tasty , whole Bronzino fish -prepared perfectly . Sides were Brussel Sprouts , Sweet Potatoes, Squash each unique flavor and wonderful.
. We stopped here on a whim because we were in the neighborhood.  We will definitely return. Delicious food.  Their pancakes are excellent!!  Very large portions and their wait staff were very good!!

If there was ever a day that they struck out on all ends this is it.
I had an opened hummus box upon delivery.  The cucumbers looked like they had been frozen.  The pita bread was crunchy and old.  Didn't even want to try the fresh berries since every thing else was a day old.
Then they sent a refund of $2.71 and then 9.58 and my order was $17.27.  
NOTHING WAS DONE RIGHT.    So I am working with no other way to get food except vending machine and then wait on refund for 10 days.
CLUSTERFUCK NOT CLUSTERTRUCK.

I try to avoid rating restaurants based solely on carry out but unfortunately with COVID I don't have another way to rate them right now. I'm new to the area and decided to give this spot a try via door dash. Even with it being delivery which we all know greatly impacts the quality of food I was overall very happy with the dishes I ordered. The only thing I wasn't completely happy with was an undercooked churro. My King's Chimichanga however was very flavorful and packed full of fillings. Huge portions! I can't wait to be able to go and try this place out in person!

I must toss another 5 star review on the pile!  This place deserves it!  The menu is a great combination of various asian cuisine, and spans everything from classic dishes like General Tso Chicken to truly unique specials!  This is my daughter's favorite restaurant, and we always leave stuffed!

I personally LOVE the hot teas!  Served steeped in a glass tea pot with a small candle underneath so it remains hot - soooooooo goooood!!
Quesadillas to die for!! Shrimp grits very tasty, pricy but worth it! Ran out of amazingly looking crawfish beignets though :(
Overpriced for an average Mediterranean food. Got kababa, wrap and baklava. Kabab was okay, disappointed with wrap and baklava. Still not worth what they are charging. Will not be going back!

Absolutely terrible. 

I came in on a Sunday night and the staff was extremely incompetent. The line cooks and cashiers were not reading the tickets correctly. I'm vegan and I sometimes fear going to omni establishments because I'm worried they'll mess up my order. This honeygrow did just that, they completely messed up my order twice. 

I ordered on their computer system and ordered whole wheat noodles. As I started eating, I noticed that my noodles were gummy and not whole wheat. I tried some of my brother's noodles to compare and my noodles were actually soba noodles. I asked the cashier if she could remake my order. It took some explaining but finally she agreed. They remade my order but I noticed that she was topping my stir fry with the toppings my older brother had ordered. Ugh I told her she was doing the wrong toppings and she just shrugged and said sorry. 

As I was eating my noodles, I found small brown bits. Possibly meat? Extremely frustrating and very disappointing. I've visited the honeygrow in University City and really enjoyed it but this location is awful. I will never go to honeygrow again.

Very mediocre Grouper sandwich. Was a bit chewy and asked for blackening but it was not. Don't bother with the slaw unless you want to put a bunch of salt and pepper on it. Very bland. Sorry but I probably won't go back.

Yesterday we went here for lunch and it was so delicious! There was a silly mix up with orders (portobello vs pork belly, makes me laugh!) But the staff was quick to fix the mistake and we SO professional and quick. We appreciated the chips & salsa on the house!
This is the best breakfast on the beach!  Awesome omelettes, french toast and bloody Mary's.  Nice service and atmosphere.

The pizza is great, but the wait and the subsequent delay is a bummer. We ordered several pizzas to feed the family, which also includes impatient kids.  I got there at the designated time, which was already an hour or so after the order was placed. I started by standing outside and waiting for someone to open the door, as it was unclear whether I was supposed to walk in or not.  After a few minutes, I tried calling the number on the door.  Called twice.  I got an answering machine that didn't indicate I had reached a number associated with the restaurant.  I was careful to confirm the number, but I don't know who I was calling.  When I got to talk to someone, I was told "12 more minutes."  It ended up a little while longer than that. Meanwhile, I walked to Vons to buy some snacks to hold the kids over.  I mean, I'm the grand scheme of things, going 20 minutes over on an order that's already supposed to take an hour might not be the worst thing, but to the several of us standing around our here, it's pretty annoying.  That said, the pizza is so good (so is the calamari) that they still get four stars, especially in light of today's extraordinary circumstances.

Pretty inconspicuous place, but the food is outstanding. We've dined in the restaurant (pre COVID-19) and ordered and were extremely happy with both.

Dine-in was a great experience. The manager came over and asked how everything was, gave us a complimentary taste of one of his favorite items, and had spot on recommendations. Cocktails were well balanced and flavorful. Portions are generous so be prepared for leftovers.

The quality of the food held up really well when we ordered.

Currently our favorite Indian spot in Philly!

Chain restaurants seem to becoming more and more obsolete these days, and for good reason. Expensive cuisine, over-priced cocktails, a boring menu... why choose to go one of these places when there are so many great locally owned restaurants around, that have flair, personality, and add something unique to your experience?

Del Frisco's of Brentwood is located in a wonderful area along Franklin Road, and is aesthetically pleasing inside. Dim lighting, but enough light where you can still take a nice photo of your food. I was with a party of 10, and we were accommodated in the back of the restaurant, away from everyone, and it was quite nice. The service was fine, and everyone's order was correct.

However, the menu at Del Frisco's is so overpriced, and why? There is nothing special about their $16 Burger, or their $32 chicken dinner. What justifies the prices? I understand high pricing when I'm at Sperry's or Ruth Chris, but Del Frisco's is way more casual. The food is not only overpriced but it does not fill you up. I ordered the Ahi Tuna tacos (which were delicious), and a salad. I had to eat again when I got home because I was still hungry! Those 2 items alone were over $30. 

I opted out of drinking because the average cocktail is around $14... and why? Why is an Old-Fashioned whiskey cocktail $3-$4 more than other restaurants in the area? What makes it so special? 

Del Frisco's is fine, but for such an expensive menu, I want my food to be more than okay. The vibe is too

I have always come to Joto's for lunch, but decided to take my 2 boys for dinner.  Went on a Friday night where they close at 10:30pm. We got there at 10:10pm They served us but, WOW they were not happy ...the staff who served  spent so much effort pressuring us to hurry up and leave the whole time we were there. So disappointed.  Not sure how many times the waitress and manager came over to ask if we were done...but it was a lot.  Sushi was good but I lost a lot of respect for them.  I won't be back--lunch or otherwise.

Finally made it in for Joseph's omakase meal. Outstanding and probably one of the best meals we have had in Philly. The taro with caviar and gold leaf blew us away, only to be followed by a steady stream of tHe best sashimi and sushii I have haD in US. Bring an excellent daiginjo sake to match the quality of this food.
We have good time enjoy the fresh fish!  The service is very good! There are a lot types of fish and choices

Used to come here as a kid and decided to give 5 happiness a try. The prices were fairly decent for appetizers, dinner and drinks. Unless like when i came here as a kids, the food was not what I remembered, I was a bit disappointed, but the service was good.

New restaurant alert! Nestled in a strip mall between Auffenberg Dealer Group and Schnucks on HWY 50 in O'Fallon, IL, you'll find this little hidden gem! You'd never guess the culture, deliciousness and sense of romance hidden inside. Incredibly friendly waitstaff, great food, romantic ambiance. Pictured: Gauchos fried cheese, Beef Milanesa a La Napolitana and the pork steak.

Maybe I just lucked out, but I thought the food and service were excellent! I came for the views, but decided to grab a Hurricane burger and strawberry colada while I waited for the rooftop to open (12 noon). Everything was so tasty! Burger was seasoned and flavorful with a butter bun too (it's the little things!). Fries were crunchy, hot, and peppered. Drink was delicious and cheap..  $6.25 for a frozen "umbrella" drink?! Yes,please! Our server, Cindy, was so friendly and helpful.. she checked on us frequently and made sure we had everything we could possibly need. This is a beach bar that really exceeded expectations!
The pork roll and cheese is to die for!!You get four slices of pork roll which is way more than any other bagel place gives!!

I'm so excited that this little taco shop opened up near me! I'm originally from San Diego and have been missing good California Mexican food and drive thru taco shops. Their menu looks awesome and just what I would have expected from back home. I had some street tacos with chicken, al pastor, and lengua and they were so flavorful and so good.  Also they have a kids menu for my anti-taco eating 4 year old and she says the chicken nuggets are amazing. This is my new go to mex place! Definitely recommend!

The golden nugget is a nice casino so its horrible that i wont be staying there again . 
First off it takes around 30 min to get anyone on the phone in reservations , which is probably due to the casino wanting to understaff and not due to the virus right now . At the busiest time during my stay there was no more that three people working the counter in the am, afternoon or dinner time . 
My stay was during Labor Day of 2020 and decided to extend my stay through Sunday to Monday as well . I called down to the front desk and was first offered a room that was a 100 dollars more than my Saturday stay and was told over the holiday weekend that would be expected. 
I then asked if there was anything that could be done since it was the last night of the holiday weekend and i was asked to hold on so he could check something .On the internet the price was a 100 less than was offered . I was told a more reasonable price then which didn't get noted.
I checked my bank account after my vacation ended and was double billed for that day and not for the same price but the original price and the internet price . 
I called and was told there were no notes and i will get my deposit back other than that not to expect to get the discounted price that was originally on the internet for that day . 
Then i got the famous have a nice day

We went here for a early day Valentines dinner and we were prepared to be disappointed from the reviews,and from a local business who seemed less than thrilled with their neighbors.

 Boy were we ever wrong in a wonderful way! We had the Italian sausage potato soup which was absolutely divine and then I had a squash ravioli with my partner having a shrimp and clam dish that was to die for!  They make all their pasta and the service was also excellent! My only comment would be they should offer bread you shouldn't have to ask for it if you want it, but everything was just wonderful.

This is the best cheesesteak in the area.  Where else can you feed two adults with one regular sandwich.   Cheesesteaks are loaded with meat.  The staff make you feel like part of the family.  Hoagies are delicious too.

A single, personable gentleman back there cooking, making everything to order, so despite the little bit of time you have to give him, I think it's the best Asian food I've had in Boise. During Covid he had my order ready on time without any issues picking it up and paying. I highly recommend, it's just so tasty.

I had an amazing time at Zahav celebrating a friend's occasion. Service was quick, attentive and extremely helpful. Food and drinks were delicious, fairly priced, and came out promptly. We tried their taste menu which I highly recommend - a little bit of everything. The Decor and ambiance was pleasant as well. The hype for this restaurant is definitely real.

Great little place to pop in and grab Delish chicken sandwich. The love bird is what I tried. Tasty with a super soft bun which was awesome. The different sauces are the clincher. I ordered fries and drowned them in the honey mustard which I give a perfect 10. Great service. Girl at counter was very friendly.

I ordered from here weekly until last week when I had a cockaroach in my food. I returned the food and received a refund..however the manager seemed unfazed "sorry the guy was here this morning to spray" and "well this IS Florida" . After this experience and speaking with others I have heard of cockaroaches crawling on the walls and in the food. Unless you looking for added bug protein in your food...I would skip it!

We had a great pre-Valentine's Day dinner tonight! For an appetizer, we tried the bruschetta with goat cheese, which was very flavorful and had a nice amount of each ingredient. I wish the bread would have been warm and toasted, but it was still really tasty! We also shared the chopped salad and the truffle mushroom pizza. They were both very flavorful! The pizza was so savory and I loved how the flavors melted together with the cheese.

We finished the meal with the tiramisu which paired nicely with the specialty Cab we were drinking throughout our meal.

I absolutely loved our wine and our food, but I honestly felt like our server was rushing us out. We were one of the only tables the restaurant had during our time there, and I felt like she made the whole meal feel very rushed. Nevertheless, we had a great time and really enjoyed our meal!

Everyone told us to expect a wait for Hattie B's and we definitely waited. For two hours. There were moments of doubt during the wait where we contemplated aborting our adventure, but at a certain point you just become too invested and the longer you wait, the longer you wait. 

When we finally got to the front of the line, I ordered the jumbo tender combo in mild. I was so hungry. I was ravenous. After ordering, we waited another 30 minutes for our food and asked the wait staff about our food. He apologized and gave us an extra order of fries to snack on while we waited for the remainder of the order. This was a nice gesture. 

When our food finally arrived, we ate soooo quickly, and it was H O T. While inhaling the food, I briefly blacked out and I'm not sure if it was due to the hunger or due to the heat. The chicken was juicy and there were more sides than what we knew what to do with. 

In all, the food was good and the service was accommodating, but I don't think it was two hours good. In the future I would probably order online at a scheduled pick up time and use that down time for other activities, or literally any other activity.

Who doesn't love a great, big, juicy burger??? Thee Burger Spot has fantastic burgers. They're a big man's comfort food...and when you bite into it, you'll totally understand. And PLEASE get onion thangs on your burger - what a great touch to step it up a notch! Delicious!

The food here will not disappoint.  We had crab cakes, great wine and seafood that tasted super fresh and was perfectly prepared.  Key lime pie was amazing!  So why not five stars?  Service.  We had empty water glasses (and wine glasses!) half of our meal.  I think maybe we caught them understaffed on a busy night.  It was a detractor from the experience nonetheless.  Definitely check out Cole's- great food experience.
It was awful and expensive.  Does not represent real Mexican food. Plus it looks dirty in there.

Located in millwoods, this restaurant was very good. I had no issues with the food at all- it was super good. My friend and I shared the popcorn chicken and I ordered the chicken Karage tappenyaki noodles, which comes with the fried chicken, noodles with mixed veggies, and an egg on top. We were also given a sample of their sweet potato fries. All of the food was very good and bursting with flavour- I have no complaints about the food. The service could have been improved though. It appears it is ran by a family, which is awesome, because I love supporting local businesses, and the woman, who would be the mom, was awesome at informing my friends and I about Taiwanese food and culture. The daughter, and our waitress, could have improved in her waitress skills though. Our appreciates we're brought out AFTER our main meals, she only filled up our little water glasses once, she reached in front of us and overtop instead of on the side, and our food was all brought out at different times- so some of my friends had to begin eating earlier so there food wouldn't get cold. The service is the only reason I took off a star, otherwise I would have gave 5 stars. I will still be back though as the food was fantastic. Thanks so much for an excellent meal and the education about Taiwan!
Very impressed. Clearly not a chain which makes this place great. Friendly service, cold beers and great food. Relaxing environment to watch the game and just hang out. Thanks for a great experience

Went to El Guero during the pandemic and sit down it's closed but they have takeout which is great. The service is fast I honestly only waited about five minutes for the food and it came out, it tasted delicious like always never a disappointment! Keep up the good work guys. We need to support this local businesses during this horrible pandemic they're doing an amazing job.
Awesome (strong) drinks.  Great staff that makes you feel like you are part of the family!  Get the shisito peppers!  Can't wait to go back!  Thanks Shane!

Just can't say enough good things about this place. Clean and quaint. Food is fabulous. Jordan was the waiter/ cashier. He is friendly, helpful, genuinely nice person. He was patient as he helped us order. These Philadelphia cheesesteaks were out of the park. So glad we decided to eat our lunch there. The fried pickles are truly outstanding as well. High marks.

We have gone many times and never disappoint! Always friendly and great service. We ordered over the phone and was able to walk in and pick up quickly. Food was hot and delicious when we got home. Always love the southern traditional sandwich as a hearty breakfast!

Thank you for your continued service and quality during the COVID pandemic!

So what I got from Paco's were the Tacos Tapatios and the Carne Asada Burrito. The Tacos Tapatios are hands down the BEST I'VE HAD. Very cheesy, the meat was tender and FLAVOR WAS GREAT! The Carne Asada burrito was flavorful and tasty. Next time I am in town I will order from Paco's again, it was great!

Disappointing, went with a party of four. I had the fish which sat on top of a crab cake.  Instead if the fish being white and flakey it was mushy, clear and lacking flavor. The crab cake was just ok. Both were overpowered by some type of sauce that was underneath the crab cake.  It was extremely rich and did not have a good flavor at all. I barely ate half of the dish.  I also ordered the she crab  bisque, it was not good.  It was watery and tasted fishy.  Two other people at my table ordered the same thing, they too were disappointed.  The service  wasn't good either.  The wait staff was inattentive throughout our entire meal.

When this location in my neighborhood got a beautiful new coat of tropical pastel paint I wasn't sure what was landing there, and I am thankful that, instead of some dreary tax office or tropical fish supply, now we have a new restaurant in my area within walking distance. Love me some Hawaiian food, and the simple menu here doesn't disappoint. Had the chicken sliders. Delicious vinegar slaw with slow cooked chicken on a toasty lil' Kings (what else) sweet roll. Nice little thin homemade bbq sauce is included but the sammies stand alone even without it.
When you can nail the flavor balance, this is how you know that there is a chef behind the scenes with a proven culinary bckd. Cue the namesake Ansley. Take a bow!
The poke bowls and tacos are a callin', so I'll see you again soon! They have  n  too if yer into that sorta thing. Also, I think there is a back outdoor seating thingie too for al fresco dining. Is it doggo friendly?

Fini's can get quite busy during the evening - this was a Friday at 5:30 and the place was packed. Luckily, we had a reservation for our group of 10. Fini's is not a big area - it's your typical bar type place. Their menu consists of burgers, salads, tacos, assorted appetizers, various sandwiches, and a pretty good selection from the bar. The food is above average - I would recommend the fish tacos - great flavors. Coconut shrimp off the appetizer menu is also very good and a large order. Service was very good all evening! Our table was right next to the outside door which was not ideal, but we "made due". Fini's tends to be very noisy, as usual with a bar, so you really can't talk too well across the table. I would recommend Fini's for a good bar environment with above average food.
Absolutely amazing the food is some of the best Mediterranean food ever. The chicken was seasoned well everything was great. I love the vibes and the decor will definitely be back.

I'm giving two stars because the employees are kind and the band playing was spectacular. Two hosts were staring at their cell phones and shuffled to set them down when we walked in. 
However, during a pandemic we all take risks going out to eat but we wanted to support something local. We should have immediately walked out when the manager, our waiter, and several other waiters were walking around and serving food with masks under their chins. My family was hungry and it was late so we stayed. Waitress came to our table with mask around neck but my son wanted to see the damn catfish and she was so nice to him! 
Long story short, the food is all frozen and absolute garbage. Pulled pork comes from some sort of package and is mush. Catfish is foul. Kids hamburger...my poor son. 
So we went next door for some ice cream, same family owns it. How can your ice cream suck?? Why is it freezer burnt??? But man, they're teaching their employees to be so kind and lay it on thick to make up for terrible food.

Great breakfast!!! Well established restaurant with a wonderful menu!!!
Plan on returning soon!!
I like the chai tea, not a big coffee person. Service is always prompt. Nice vibe. I will be trying the food next time for breakfast
NOFW partnered with W Hotel French Quarter to host What She Said event and everything was amazing! Fabulous courtyard, Fabulous view, Fabulous bar, food & service! All the boxes checked off A+!

We had to order for delivery via Grubhub because of lockdown.  Until yesterday I didn't even know we had a second Japanese restaurant in D-town.  The pork gyoza and its dipping sauce are delicious, the chicken katsu is right on the money, and the sukiyaki is very flavorful, although slightly sweeter than I'm used to.  The sukiyaki could have used a little more broth, but the udon noodles were cooked perfectly.  The shaved beef in it kind of stuck together in little balls, so that I had to break it apart.  It was delicious, regardless.  The order even came with chopsticks, so I didn't have to break out my own supply of them!  I will be ordering from them again.  My overall verdict is ... chef's kiss.

May I suggest: 

They may have changed ownership, but the food is still of the same "made with love" quality I enjoy when I come here. I have been a regular here for three years and have acquired some faves. I would go with their half portion deli sandwich with half size house salad. I substitute the chips for side of their orzo pasta salad to round off the meal. Their seemingly plain deli sandwiches are made wirh the most tender cuts of meat and are petfrctly nestled on a soft roll. I can easily rip the sandwiches with my fingers with not alot of effort. My other favorite is half size salad with a cup of their tomato bisque soup. No exaggeration, they make THE best tomato bisque I've ever had with the rich tomato flavor and hearty croutons in it. They do offer specials each month that look very interesting and I do make a note to try. Definitely in the bucket list is their mac n cheese and wings.

Great food and service every time. The cheesesteaks and chicken tenders are definitely top notch and the fries are typically perfect but if you like them salty I would specify. I eat here a lot cuz it's down the street and the quality is very consistent, nice people!
Twisted Fork has great food and I always ask for the specials to determine what I get.  Me and my wife frequent here often as it is one of the best restaurants in South Reno.
Had a sausage & biscuit & frappe. floors were filthy, girl was nice behind the counter. Sausage biscuit was ok , it actually was a little buttery which was nice. Frappe was good. That's about it.

This is my father's favorite restaurant in town. We've been coming here for twenty some years, since I was a little kid. It has such a unique location and decor, in an old bank, and the bizarre picture of the screaming greek satyr (which is a sculpture by Bernini the Renaissance artist) always cracks me up. I find this place a mixed bag. I must've been here fifty times in my life, and sometimes I love my meal and a couple times I've been really annoyed, but I think that happens anywhere you go 50 times. (And it was usually service that offended me the couple times I wasn't happy.) I enjoy their flatbread pizzas. They're really salty and flavorful. My dad dreams of their seafood pasta. Every meal comes with great bread and garlic herb butter. It's cozy, a great vibe, a great location. You can sit outside on 7th Avenue and watch people stroll by. I bring friends here when they come to town as one of the highlights of Ybor City!

This place is fun. Authentic seafood spot on the pier. Expect to wait a long time - sign in up front and wait for your table. Once you get it, the service is great and not rushed. All of the shellfish is super fresh and yes, I believe it is all shellfish, not fish. 

Jennifer totally made my day with her upbeat energy and pulling box crabs out and sharing an abalone with the child at the table next to us. The food is so fresh my uni was waving it's thorns around when it got to the table. It's also really good. 

We had uni with scallops which I love, cioppino which was good but not SF good, and a fried mix of shellfish which was delicious. Also some oyster shooters. It was all delicious and I can not wait to come back.

They have certain things we really enjoy and stick with. Any of the dishes with battered chicken are wonderful- sweet and sour chicken or sesame chicken. The veggie Lo mein is also yummy and if you're interested in a new soup option the west lake beef soup is tasty! Kind of like an egg drop soup with beef and cilantro.

I chose the Indian Rocks Rd location and I ordered 2 acai' bowls at the take out window there. My bowls were filled with fresh fruit, granola & really tasty acai'. The staff working were friendly & helped guide my decisions about my order.  They were also informative about some questions I had regarding their fresh cold pressed juices. This location is convenient for parents who like the convenience of a drive thru. It also is close to many parks and the beach, so it's a nice treat to beat the heat.
This was my grandmother's favorite place to go out to eat. A decade later I'm still ordering her favorite dinner at her favorite place like nothing has changed; thank you so much for that.

10 stars read further but spend your time in a more productive way and just go!
Another gem found by accident - we drove by the night before saw the sign Coffee & Drive through my best friend knew I was coming back and she told no lies.
So happy we did.
Ok the great stuff the deco outside is super cute.  Pull up the nicest most welcoming human pops out asked "have you been here before" boom gives us paper menus that we keep because they are 100% touch less!
It's covid an amazing plus.
Reads off the specials sees fudge (my dog) and immediately becomes his best friend by offering him (she asked me first) a huge piece of delicious bacon.
Well that's just the start - the coffee delicious, the maple latte amazing, chocolate croissant honestly how did they make it taste like chocolate jam! Bacon egg & cheese pressed on the most amazing croissant and then to end I got a gingerbread person!  That's what she called them and welp they now have a loyal lifetime customer.
Go here for the service for the delicious pastries for the exceptional coffee for the drive they experience for the touch less transaction honestly just go!
Note they use local everything so they are supporting their community on top of everything else!

They make some of their salad dressings in house. Their thousand island dressing is on fire!
